candidate_free_baseline.state: working tree nao commitado; nenhum candidato produtivo P1342/P1343 presente nos dez consumers

observable_scope: deterministic inverse normalization of every live candidate consumer to its pinned whole-file candidate-free SHA-256
lexically real, unique, non-overlapping and allowlisted P1343 capsule markers
exact replacement bytes, cfg predicate, Rust owner symbol or branch, before and after anchors for every capsule
source-derived binding of H00D, H00S and H01-H16 at the real productive callsites
exactly one append-only raw-ledger writer and read-only projections
runtime coverage from the 178-byte fixture in fresh normal, repeat and reverse executions
inspectable Preserved and deliberately opaque Unknown only after all non-payload predicates pass
out_of_scope: general retention, discard, invalidation or terminal-policy closure
functional equivalence beyond the focal binding
public API, default behavior, compatibility or pipeline phase changes

capsule_policy.normalization: The verifier independently scans full-line Rust comment markers, replaces each complete capsule at descending live offsets with the manifest-pinned candidate-free bytes, and requires the normalized complete-file digest. It does not trust DTO ranges, hashes, booleans or aliases.
capsule_policy.insert: The pinned replacement is empty and the candidate body is entirely guarded by cfg(p1339_observation) or cfg(all(test, p1339_observation)).
capsule_policy.replace: The candidate body contains an exact normal branch under not(p1339_observation) and a separate observed branch; normal build and syntax gates remain mandatory.
capsule_policy.closed_world: Unknown IDs, missing or duplicate IDs, nesting, overlap, edits outside capsules, false replacement bytes, wrong cfg, wrong symbol or altered normal branch are Violated.
capsule_policy.protected_after_seal: The step, this manifest, capsule baseline, L0 freeze, fixture, contract, source verifier, oracle corpus and preseal receipt become read-only once SEALED_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION is issued.

unknown_policy: Missing marker, capsule, hook, identity, cfg, anchor, reachability, cardinality, topology, source binding or external evidence is Violated. Unknown is allowed only for an explicitly authored opaque payload after every structural, causal and non-payload predicate passes.

root.role: human-intent capture, authority manifest and orchestration
root.writes: p1343-authority-manifest.json only before contract; no oracle, attack, seal or final certificate
root.forbidden: approve its own baseline, contract, implementation or final verdict

baseline_authority.reads: step, frozen predecessors, ten L0 owners and ten consumers; no future candidate

contract_author.reads: step, this manifest, frozen baseline, L0 freeze, fixture and P1342 contract; no future candidate
contract_author.forbidden: candidate code, tests, oracle, attack, seal or final certificate

oracle_author.reads: frozen step, manifest, baseline and contract; no future candidate
oracle_author.writes: new p1343-source-verifier-*, p1343-oracle-* and focal authorship receipt only
oracle_author.forbidden: full corpus, candidate code, tests, attack, seal or final certificate

adversary.reads: frozen step, manifest, baseline, contract and oracle; no future candidate
adversary.forbidden: correct the verifier or choose the solution

preseal_verifier.reads: all protected inputs and independent outputs; no future candidate
preseal_verifier.forbidden: edit any judged artifact; more than one full preseal execution

ab_tester.reads: frozen L0, fixture, contract, source verifier and seal; no candidate patch
ab_tester.writes: new p1343 implementation test and RED receipt only
ab_tester.forbidden: adapt the test after reading implementation

implementer.reads: frozen L0, contract, baseline, source verifier, seal and RED; no private tester reasoning
implementer.writes: only the 36 allowlisted capsules, test include switch if assigned, and implementation receipt
implementer.forbidden: edit protected inputs, add capsules, write outside capsules or issue a verdict

final_verifier.reads: all sealed inputs, candidate sources and candidate outputs
final_verifier.writes: new p1343-verifier-candidate-* and final certificate only
final_verifier.forbidden: modify any judged artifact; more than one full final execution

stop_conditions: Two focal attempts repeat the same classification vector and public cause.
A required candidate edit cannot be represented by one of the 36 frozen capsules and normalize to the ten pinned baseline hashes.
Any protected input changes after seal or an authority writes outside its allowlist.
Any relevant negative survives or mutation score is below 1.0.
Implementation requires an ADR-0127 public, default, phase or compatibility change.
The only available progress would weaken a negative, trust candidate-authored evidence or broaden scope.
